data.narrative:
Reflex Aerospace is a Series A space and aerospace company that has raised €50M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs, alongside 3 direct-stage comparables in the Space & Aerospace sector.

Two methods are applicable here. Stage-progression anchors to the €50M raised as a proxy for current value, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression, yielding €100M. Peer-median valuation uses three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies—Cowboy Space Corporation (€2.0B, Series B), Aalyria (€1.3B, Series B), and Starcloud (€1.1B, Seed)—producing a median of €1.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not on file, though the median public Space & Aerospace P/S is 25.3x.

These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of €85M to €1.5B, with a median estimate of €700M. The wide dispersion reflects structural uncertainty: stage-progression is conservative and capital-efficiency focused, while peer-median is benchmarked to later-stage rounds and may overweight outlier valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, unit economics, and whether the peer set adequately captures Reflex's differentiation within satellite or launch subsectors.
